lucy (PM): Dropping a fresh compact-roles prototype. Main asks: 1) make SSO enforcement feel like policy not a footnote, 2) ensure keyboard discoverability in dense layouts, 3) clarify where audit links land. Fig: https://figma.com/file/roles-compact-2209 :mag_right:

marc (Designer): Pushed two variants: 'policy badge' (small filled chip with tooltip) and 'enforcement row' (row-level strip that appears when a role needing SSO is hovered/selected). Policy badge is lighter visually; enforcement row is more obvious but heavier UI.

tobias (Frontend): Enforcement row is better for discoverability but we must avoid layout shift. If it slides in, reserve vertical space or overlay it so the CTA doesn't jump. Also keyboard focus order must remain stable when the row appears.

anya (Backend): Backend can provide `sso_policy` on role objects: values ["none","optional","enforced"]. We'll also emit `audit_anchor_id` on invite creates so frontend can deep-link to exact audit timeline anchor. No objections.

anya-a11y (a11y): A11y notes: 1) Policy needs explicit SR phrasing: e.g., when selecting role announce: "Billing Admin selected. SSO policy: enforced." 2) For enforcement row don't shift focus; instead use a visible outline on the row and populate a polite live region. 3) If using overlay panel for policy details, ensure `role="dialog"`, trap focus, and return focus to triggering control.

marc (Designer): For microcopy I'm considering: header badge text options: "SSO enforced", "SSO required", "Enforced by org SSO". Which is clearest? Also tooltip copy should be one short sentence + link to docs.

lucy (PM): Short & explicit. Prefer "SSO enforced" for badges and tooltip: "This role requires signing in with your organizations SSO provider. Learn more." Keep link target to /docs/sso-roles.

tobias (Frontend): Implementation plan: 1) consume `sso_policy` on roles GET, 2) render policy badge for all roles (small pill), but show enforcement-row only when a role with policy=enforced is focused/selected, using absolute positioning to avoid reflow, 3) add `aria-live="polite"` span that updates: "Selected role: Billing Admin. SSO: enforced." 4) ensure tab order: email -> role grid -> policy info -> send.

anya-a11y (a11y): Use simple phrasing in the live region. Prefer polite for non-critical status. Also for the badge/info button, include `aria-describedby` to point to the longer tooltip content for SR users.

anya (Backend): On the audit side we'll accept "/audit?anchor=<audit_anchor_id>&context=invite_modal". Frontend can add `#anchor-<id>` so scrolling pinpoints the event. We'll include a short `context_label` in the response so audit can show "From Invite Modal" chip.

marc (Designer): UX idea: when deep-linking from modal, show a small context chip next to audit filters reading "From invite modal" + subtle pulse for 1s. For reduced motion users fallback to a static border highlight. Also add a quick "Return to invite" link at top of audit page when context is present.

tobias (Frontend): For the pulse I'll do CSS animation wrapped in `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference)`. For focusing the anchored item, prefer setting tabindex=-1 then call element.focus(); announce via live region: "Focused audit entry created from invite modal." If the user uses keyboard to continue, focus remains on anchor.

anya-a11y (a11y): Good. Make sure the anchor receives a meaningful accessible name: e.g., use aria-label "Invite audit for user@example.com" and the live region message should include the reason/context.

lucy (PM): Decision log so far: 1) show small policy badge for discoverability (text: "SSO enforced"); 2) when enforced role selected show enforcement-row overlay (absolute positioned) not shifting CTA; 3) add polite live region announcements on role select; 4) backend to return `sso_policy` and `audit_anchor_id` + `context_label`; 5) audit page shows context chip + anchors the event and offers "Return to invite". Any objections?

marc (Designer): No objections. I'll update fig to reserve overlay space so it doesn't cover vital controls on small screens and include the context chip mock in audit frames.

tobias (Frontend): I'll wire `sso_policy` consumption, the overlay enforcement-row, live region updates, and audit deep-link handler. Also test keyboard roving behavior for dense grid (arrow keys).

anya (Backend): I'll add `sso_policy` to role list and include `audit_anchor_id` and `context_label` on invite create responses today. Also adding error 409 `ROLE_SSO_CONFLICT` if someone bypasses preflight.

anya-a11y (a11y): After PR I'll run keyboard + NVDA + VoiceOver passes with the overlay and anchored auditing flows. Check contrast for badge (>=4.5:1).

audit-bot: note: recorded change type: UI/UX small; audit anchor supported.

lucy (PM): Timeline: Marc updates figma today, Anya (backend) lands API by EOD, Tobias starts frontend tomorrow, A11y review after PR. Thanks all. If bulk CSV or delegated invites should be considered, flag here and we'll add follow-up. :sparkles:
